metadata.description: Official TesterPayKit Claude Code marketplace — ships the tpk plugin (tpk CLI skills + the remote testerpaykit MCP server for ordering tests with real testers on the TPK crowd-testing platform).

plugins.name: tpk
plugins.description: TesterPayKit plugin — bootstrap a TPK project incl. payout rule, integrate the SDK into Flutter (testerpaykit + moinsen_runapp), Expo/React-Native (@testerpaykit/expo), Web/TypeScript (@testerpaykit/react), or native Swift (TesterPayKit Swift Package, early access) apps, query sessions/bugs/recruiting, install the tpk CLI from pub.dev, order tests with real human testers and read their results over the remote testerpaykit MCP server (/tpk:connect), and close the agentic feedback loop via /tpk:fix-next-bug. Skills are namespaced /tpk:* so they're easy to find. Real testers report, Claude fixes, you ship.
